title: comfy nodes *
description: Output shape for node introspection commands (ls, show, search, upstream, downstream, path, types, categories) and the annotation-cache refresh (refresh).

refreshed.description: True only when every annotation file was re-fetched from the remote (refresh). False when any fell back to the bundled snapshot — including the intentional COMFY_CLI_NO_REMOTE_REFRESH case, which is not an error.

files.description: Per-file result of the annotation refresh (refresh).

source.description: Where the bytes came from: freshly fetched, the package-bundled snapshot, or nothing at all.

path.description: Cache file the data was written to, or null when nothing was persisted. Both documents share one cache file, so both rows report the same path.

error.description: Why the remote fetch was not used. Present only when source is not 'remote'.

cache_error.description: Why fetched data could not be written to disk. Present only when source is 'remote' and path is null — the fetch itself succeeded, so this is not a network failure.

knowledge.description: Curated model knowledge matching this call; absent when no bundle is loaded or nothing matched.
